name: MCPGate
description: MCPGate aggregates multiple MCP servers into a single unified endpoint, enabling centralized tool management with granular filtering, automatic namespacing, and observability. Features a real-time web dashboard and optional PostgreSQL-backed audit trails for monitoring and controlling AI tool access across local and remote deployments.
